description: T-0969 attempt 9: does T.DIST.RT call BETA.DIST's kernel? Column A t, B df; C T.DIST.RT(t,df); D y = df/(df+t*t) as the worksheet rounds it; E BETA.DIST(y,df/2,0.5,TRUE) and F E/2 (compare with C); G z = t*t/(df+t*t); H BETA.DIST(z,0.5,df/2,TRUE) and I BETA.DIST(1-y,0.5,df/2,TRUE) (the centre); J T.DIST(t,df,FALSE) and K BETA.DIST(y,df/2,0.5,FALSE) (the densities, f_t = t df/(df+t^2)^2 f_B); L T.DIST(-t,df,TRUE).
